populations.clip: usable, primary-evaluation clips (no contested/combo/quarantined); clip label = argmax of mean log-prob over quality-passing frames with u in [0.2, 0.8] (all frames if none pass)
populations.frame_calibration: quality-passing frames of primary clips with u in [0.1, 0.9], after the cross-fit temperature
populations.ci: patient-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples (group bootstrap reported alongside); Wilson for single proportions

checks: folds --verify passes (no group, md5 or near-duplicate group in two splits; no full-length rows)
every model input is exactly 0 outside the aperture mask (augment.assert_batch_masked in train.py, tests)
badge boxes are 0 in model inputs

G-PIPELINE.what: label-permutation run (configs/sanity_perm.json, fold 0): a pipeline-bug test, not a leakage test

checks: leak_audit.py passes: no cross-split pair above T_dup (embeddings) and no cross-split pair under the gain-invariant dHash near-duplicate rule
required planted controls are caught: the re-exported copy (embedding), the 2 px shift + JPEG q75 + 3% gain copy (embedding OR dHash rule) and every known re-encode (embedding)

G-MODEL.on_failure: NO-GO (landmarks computed and logged with display=false)

G-SHORTCUT.nbi_effect: P(oesophageal region | NBI frame) - P(oesophageal region | WL frame) for NON-oesophageal true stations, stratified by true station (weights min(n_wl, n_nbi)), quality-passing frames
G-SHORTCUT.mode_switch_effect: paired within-clip mean difference NBI minus WL frames of P(oesophageal region), mixed-mode non-oesophageal clips
G-SHORTCUT.cap_effect: P(z_line | cap, true station != z_line) - P(z_line | no cap, true station != z_line), stratified by true station
G-SHORTCUT.positive_control: a fold-0 model trained on UNMASKED canvases (configs/sanity_unmasked.json) must exceed at least one of the limits above, or the badge-paste counterfactual effect must exceed 0.05
G-SHORTCUT.on_failure: remediate (grayscale p=0.3, gradient-reversal mode head) and re-run; else NO-GO

per_mode.wl_level: patient: one vote per patient (>= half of their WL clips of the station right), Wilson lower bound over patients
per_mode.note: WL oesophagus is scarce (dev WL proximal ~7 patients): the bound needs 7/7 at n=7 (6/7 -> 0.487), 8/9 at n=9, 12/15 at n=15. Serving has ONE auto_enabled flag per station, so a WL failure makes the station manual-only in NBI too; gates_result.json also records auto_enabled_by_mode for a future mode-aware tracker.

G-STATION.on_failure: auto_enabled[k] = false: candidate display plus manual tick only
G-STATION.s4_fdr_source: tune_tracker nested held-out replay (tuned tracker and thresholds per outer fold), station ENABLED: heldout_pooled.S4.fdr_per_station_if_enabled
G-STATION.nested: tune_tracker recomputes auto_enabled per outer fold k from these criteria on the folds != k (critic C4); the shipped auto_enabled is evaluate --report on all dev OOF

G-STREAM.evaluated_on: dev OOF, nested tracker tuning (tune_tracker.py held-out folds) on the SHIPPED station set: auto_enabled recomputed per outer fold and applied (disabled stations count in no stream metric); transit frames classified by the fold models (transit_source=model)
G-STREAM.on_failure: retune on dev only: tune_tracker --disable <station> (the station with the worst held-out S4 FDR or recall first, one at a time; recorded as force_disabled) until G-STREAM passes on the shipped station set; if no non-empty station set passes: NO-GO

ece_fallback.fallback_model: the fold model with the MEDIAN inner-val clip macro-F1, with its own cross-fit calibration; its test result is reported as a pre-named second look

protocol.transit: model: the final all-dev model classifies the synthetic transit frames at the shipped T; must equal tracker.json transit_source, otherwise nothing is scored (evaluate.check_test_protocol)
protocol.auto_enabled: the shipped auto_enabled (gates_result.json); references are tracker.json heldout_pooled (same station set rules)
protocol.ci_simulation: evaluate --ci-sim resamples test-sized patient sets WITH replacement from dev OOF

G-SHIFT.note: legacy 1350 cohort stays unsupported_layout in serving regardless

G-SERVE.note: measured in I1 (bench.py sustained on staging with drained burst credit; tests/test_landmark_parity.py)

outcomes.computed_by: evaluate.outcome -> gates_result.json 'outcome' (PENDING while a blocking gate has not run)
outcomes.GO: all blocking gates pass (G-STREAM included) and every G-STATION-k passes
outcomes.PARTIAL: all blocking gates pass, with G-STREAM measured on the shipped station set (per-fold auto_enabled plus any dev-only --disable retune); >= 1 station auto-enabled; the failed G-STATION-k stations are manual-only (auto_enabled=false)
outcomes.NO-GO: a blocking gate fails, or no station is auto-enabled: shadow logging only
